avoid_supplements.name: Nitrates (organic nitrates, poppers)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive vasodilation leading to severe hypotension, syncope, myocardial infarction, or stroke
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid all nitrate-containing products and alkyl nitrites

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces tadalafil plasma concentrations and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative antidepressant if tadalafil required

avoid_supplements.name: Yohimbine
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive sympathomimetic effects; increased blood pressure and cardiac strain
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel on alternative erectile dysfunction support

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild CYP3A4-inducing properties; potential modest reduction in tadalafil levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced efficacy; reassess if erectile dysfunction control declines

caution_supplements.name: Saw Palmetto
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 interaction; minimal clinical significance in most patients
caution_supplements.action: No specific restriction; standard monitoring recommended

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases tadalafil bioavailability and plasma concentrations, elevating hypotension and adverse effect risk
avoid_foods.action: Advise patient to avoid grapefruit products; consider dose adjustment if consumption unavoidable

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay tadalafil absorption and reduce peak plasma concentration; minimal impact on overall efficacy with once-daily dosing
caution_foods.action: Counsel that tadalafil can be taken with or without food; consistent timing recommended

caution_foods.name: Excessive alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive vasodilation and hypotensive effects; increased dizziness, headache, and syncope risk
caution_foods.action: Advise limiting alcohol consumption; educate on increased adverse event risk with heavy use

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure regularly, especially in patients taking antihypertensive agents concurrently. Counsel patients on absolute contraindication with nitrates and importance of disclosing all supplements and foods to prevent serious cardiovascular complications.
